name: 一拖二无线领夹降噪麦克风款

category.leaf: 一拖二无线领夹麦克风

description: 手机相机即插即用、双通道同录、户外防风降噪收音

styleLock.direction: professional audio-gear ecommerce, creator-grade and clean
styleLock.backgroundSystem: snow-white seamless field for the packshot, warm oatmeal concentric-arc panels for benefit and info screens, muted real environments for scene screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused key from the front-left, restrained rim sweep, gentle contact shadows, neutral studio grade, no harsh specular bursts
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte graphite product bodies on oatmeal board and light-stone counters, deep graphite surface for macro
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held in the style system only, every glyph area left blank for post-composited copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip frames, one accent colour, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 to straight-on product scale, collars and connector edges always readable, never overlapped by props or hands
noDrift: no rendered in-image copy, badges or model numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent professional audio-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of snow-white #FFFFFF, warm oatmeal #F2ECE4, graphite #2A2A2C and mist silver #9AA9B2; neutral studio grade lighting with a soft diffused front-left key, restrained rim sweep and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin single-weight line icons and empty rounded chip frames only; matte anodised product bodies with fine surface texture and one controlled specular roll; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic scaffolding; stable slight 3/4 to straight-on product scale and centring; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表首图，用干净双机立姿一眼点进来
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, two upright units centred, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key, front-left softbox key with a bounce card on the shadow side
shots.whitespace: even margin all around, no extra whitespace and no copy band
shots.promptTemplate: White-background marketplace hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One transmitter standing upright beside its receiver, both fully visible in a straight-on eye-level view, centred and symmetrical so the search thumbnail reads as a clean silhouette. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left softbox key and a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding each unit so nothing floats. Seamless snow-white background #FFFFFF, matte anodised bodies showing fine surface texture and one controlled specular roll. No props, no hands, no cables. The two units occupy 60-70% of the frame. Even margin all around the product, no extra whitespace and no copy band. 1:1, 8K commercial electronics e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmark or logo, no printed or rendered text of any kind, no packaging art, no hands, no watermark or QR code, no gradient or tinted background, no clipped edges, no duplicated product parts.

shots.intent: 一秒交代整机结构与可换防风帽、背夹、接口形态
shots.camera: very low angle looking upward, three units suspended on tilted diagonal axes
shots.lighting: soft diffused top light with a cool rim sweep from the right, faint shadows floating just beneath each unit
shots.props: two thin single-weight line icons only
shots.whitespace: clean untouched band across the top 20% holding no glyphs
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three units suspended on tilted diagonal axes inside a set of concentric arcs, photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the clip arm, the charging contacts, the interchangeable cap and the connector blade all read at once. Soft diffused top light with a cool rim sweep from the right edge, faint believable shadows floating just below each unit. Background of layered warm oatmeal concentric arcs #E4DBD2 over a pale face, one panel only, no scenic depth. Props limited to two thin single-weight line icons, no accessories. The three units occupy 50-60% of the frame overall. Clean untouched band across the top 20% that carries no glyphs, no badges and no graphics. 1:1, crisp commercial rendering. Negative: no rendered words or numbers, no speed lines or burst graphics, no real competitor product, no mismatched lighting between the three units, no floating unit without a soft shadow, no watermark.

shots.intent: 放大手机自带麦远距离收音发糊、风噪人声不清的痛点
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down, documentary slight-handheld feel
shots.lighting: directional lower-key light weighing on the problem side, cleaner softer light on the solution side
shots.background: crowd bokeh in deep olive-grey #5B5850 on the left, clean oatmeal panel #F2ECE4 on the right
shots.props: market stall clutter on the problem side only
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the two states read edge to edge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point contrast screen featuring {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left two-thirds: a slab smartphone held at arm's length across a windy crowded street-market stall, its capture point far from the speaker, a dense jagged waveform hanging above it. Right third: {product} clipped close to a collar with calm sparse waveform bars above it. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down with a documentary slight-handheld feel; directional lower-key light weighs on the problem side while a cleaner softer light resolves the solution side. Background of crowd bokeh in deep olive-grey #5B5850 on the left and a clean oatmeal panel #F2ECE4 on the right, both matched in crop height. Props: market stall clutter only where it embodies the noise problem. The scene occupies 40-50% of the frame. No extra whitespace, the two states read edge to edge. Negative: no readable signage or storefront lettering, no shop name or original-platform watermark, no identifiable face, no fabricated statistics or level numbers, no dense body text, no rendered copy.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏波形疏密差证明降噪，不写任何数值主张
shots.camera: matched straight-on framing, identical crop and lens height on both panels
shots.lighting: soft even front-left studio light, identical on both panels, gentle contact shadow
shots.background: clean warm neutral #EFE9E1 across both panels
shots.whitespace: empty strip along the top of each panel carrying no glyphs
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce before-and-after comparison of {product}, two matched panels with identical framing, identical light and identical crop. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: the unit shown straight-on at mid-height with its furry cap ringed by a busy dense waveform inside an empty rounded frame. Right panel: the same unit in exactly the same position, its waveform smoothed and sparse inside a matching rounded frame, the only difference being the wave shape. Soft even front-left studio light, gentle contact shadow under each body, colour temperature held neutral. Background of clean warm neutral #EFE9E1 across both panels with one thin single-weight divider line. Props limited to two empty rounded waveform frames, no icons with labels. Each panel's unit occupies 50-60% of its own half. An empty strip along the top of each panel carries no glyphs and no claim wording. Negative: no rendered labels or numbers, no real competing brand implied, no fabricated measurement or percentage, no differing camera angle between panels, no arrow clutter, no watermark.

shots.intent: 代入户外开拍场景，证明接收端直插手机即可录
shots.camera: eye level from a 3/4 rear angle beside the holder's hand
shots.lighting: warm late-afternoon light filtering from the upper left, 5500K core with golden bokeh, soft natural falloff
shots.background: out-of-focus autumn undergrowth in deep amber-brown #5A4632
shots.props: one slab smartphone and one hand only
shots.whitespace: generous blurred negative space across the upper 25%
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle use scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A hand holding a slab smartphone upright with the receiver plugged into its bottom edge, photographed at eye level from a 3/4 rear angle beside the holder so the screen reads as a blank viewfinder with no readable interface, no icons and no numbers. Warm late-afternoon light filtering from the upper left, 5500K core mixed with golden bokeh highlights, soft natural falloff and honest skin texture on the hand. Background of out-of-focus autumn undergrowth in deep amber-brown #5A4632, with the person beyond the phone cropped below the nose or turned away so no identity is legible. Props limited to the phone and one hand, nothing overlapping the product. The phone and receiver occupy 40-50% of the frame. Generous blurred negative space across the upper 25% kept free of any copy or badge. 1:1, candid believable texture with slight grain. Negative: no recognizable face or eye detail, no on-screen interface glyphs, no phone brand mark or distinctive camera bump, no floating receiver without contact, no ring-light artifact, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 展示双人各自佩戴同录的使用方式，完成身份代入
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward, as if from a phone propped on a camp table
shots.lighting: soft diffused daylight entering the tent opening from the front-right, gentle interior bounce, low contrast
shots.background: warm canvas and blurred foliage in muted khaki #7C6E58
shots.props: one enamel mug and a folded blanket at the frame edge
shots.whitespace: clean empty space across the top third with no copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle two-person recording scene featuring {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two creators seated shoulder to shoulder inside a canvas tent, each wearing one transmitter clipped to a collar, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward as if from a phone propped on a camp table, both heads cropped out above the chin so neither face is identifiable. Soft diffused daylight entering the tent opening from the front-right with gentle interior bounce and low contrast. Background of warm canvas and blurred foliage in muted khaki #7C6E58. Props: one enamel mug and a folded blanket at the frame edge, never covering either collar. The two clipped units occupy 40-50% of the frame overall. Clean empty space across the top third that holds no text and no badges. Negative: no recognizable face, no celebrity likeness, no brand labels on clothing, no third or duplicated microphone, no mismatched shadow direction, no watermark, no rendered copy.

shots.intent: 铺开设播客、探店、教学、演出等用途面，扩大受众自认
shots.camera: each panel straight-on at eye level with identical lens height
shots.lighting: consistent soft daylight-weighted light in all six panels, unified shadow direction from the left
shots.background: pale oatmeal card #F2ECE4 with even gutters
shots.props: one small empty rounded caption bar under each panel
shots.whitespace: generous empty margin above the grid carrying no headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce scenario matrix of {product}: a two-by-three grid of six matched vignettes, a desk talking-head setup, a forest interview, a street food stall, a classroom lectern, a piano bench and a conference podium, each showing the clipped unit at collar or desk height. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Every panel photographed straight-on at eye level with the same lens height, figures cropped below the chin or shown from behind so no identity reads. Consistent soft daylight-weighted lighting across all six panels with a unified shadow direction from the left. Panels sit on a pale oatmeal card #F2ECE4 with even gutters, each closed by one small empty rounded caption bar. The six vignettes together occupy 40-50% of the frame. Generous empty margin above the grid carrying no headline, no glyph and no badge. Negative: no readable signage or storefront lettering, no real event or venue branding, no recognizable face, no inconsistent panel brightness, no duplicated product within one panel, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用绒毛与机身肩线微距证明做工与风噪处理
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro in clean 90-degree side profile, tight zoom, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: single soft skimming light sweeping from the left at low incidence, one restrained specular line on the shoulder
shots.background: deep graphite studio surface #2A2A2C, no horizon
shots.whitespace: minimal margin, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the silver-grey furry windscreen cap where it meets the matte body shoulder and the clip hinge. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera set in a clean 90-degree side profile with shallow depth of field, front fibre tips razor sharp and the body falling softly out of focus. Single soft skimming light sweeping from the left at a low incidence to read every fibre, with one restrained specular line along the anodised shoulder. Background of a deep graphite studio surface #2A2A2C with no horizon. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal margin since the texture is the subject. 4K macro commercial quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no melting or duplicated fibres, no visible wordmark on the body, no dust or scratches implying damage, no spilled highlight bloom, no extra text, no watermark.

shots.intent: 交底随附配件与适配面，消除到手落差风险
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat studio lighting, no dramatic shadow, neutral colour temperature
shots.props: spare caps, short cable, six empty unbranded device-silhouette frames
shots.whitespace: generous even gutters between rows, no copy band
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and contents screen of {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two transmitters, one receiver with its small flat connector blade, two spare foam caps, two furry caps and one short cable laid in tidy parallel rows on a matte oatmeal board #F5F1EA, every piece carrying its own soft contact shadow. Along the top edge sit six empty unbranded device-silhouette frames and blank rounded chip outlines, deliberately left with no glyphs, no model names and no numbers. Even high-key flat studio lighting with no dramatic shadow and a neutral colour temperature. The laid-out contents occupy 35-40% of the frame. Generous even gutters between rows, no copy band needed. Negative: no real phone or console silhouette, no certification seals or test-report artwork, no warranty or rating badges, no invented counts or numbers, no packaging art, no shadow mismatch, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：图1 雪白底双发射器带绒毛防风帽、接收器直插头、备用海绵帽与转接头平铺；图2 手持平板手机底部直插接收器、户外落叶林虚化、顶部横排大字；图3 帐篷内两人胸前各夹一枚发射器自拍、顶部双行大字；图4 三枚机身斜置悬浮于米色同心弧前、顶部双行大字；图5 两枚带绒帽机身并列、上方密集波形与方框内平滑波形；图6 接收器直插头、带帽机身与转接头并列、上方一排平板机型插画；图7 两行三列六格用途小图、顶部双行大字。品类判定：主产品为夹在衣领、经接收器直插手机或相机拾音的无线领夹麦克风套组，核心是音频采集，故判为手机数码／耳机音频，而非源站所挂类目，也非摄影支架类。已剥离：源品牌字标与机身字样、原平台店铺水印与角标、全部原英文标题句式与图内文案、机型插画的品牌特征与镜头排布、出镜人物面容与身份（改为颈部以下裁切或背影）、手机屏幕内的界面与读数（改为空白取景框）、波形上的任何量化主张（改为空参数栏与空圆角标签框）。
